items.author: Michael McCusker, Nov 15
items.summary: "Did Tableau Data Apps just solve the Export to Excel issue?" A "Refresh Monitor" Data App on Tableau Public with a clean Excel export: controlled column set and order, no leading ' mark, multi-worksheet splits and an info sheet, plus slide-overs and an email-the-owner action. 13 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.
